samples.summary: `FontRegistry.ensureFont` short-circuits on `document.fonts.check`, which a subset preview face can now satisfy — caching the family as fully 'loaded'
samples.evidence: packages/docs/src/view/fonts.ts:302-305 marks a family `loaded` (permanently, in `this.status`) whenever `document.fonts.check('12px "Family"')` is true, and skips `document.fonts.load`. Before this change the only face a picker/dialog preview could register for a family was the FULL css2 face, so that short-circuit was sound. Now `ensurePreviewFontLink` registers a `&text=`-subset face under the same family name; once the picker paints the label that face reaches `loaded`, so `check()` can answer true for a family whose full faces were never fetched. The reachable entry point is packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:350-354 (`ensureFontLink(family)` then `store.fonts?.ensureFont?.(family)`), which fires immediately after the full <link> is appended but before its CSS resolves — exactly the window where only the subset face is registered. Consequence: the registry never awaits the full load and never fires its re-layout listeners, so the Canvas renderer can keep measuring/painting the subset (label-only glyphs) or fallback. Confidence is low only because `store.fonts` appears unwired today (no `new FontRegistry()` anywhere in packages/*/src), so the path may be dormant; the class is exported publicly at packages/docs/src/index.ts:188. Fix belongs on the new code (or on `ensureFont`): a subset face must not be indistinguishable from a full load to `document.fonts` consumers.

samples.summary: The Recent rows can only supply `weights` from the curated catalog, so a full-library recent that ships no 400 cut gets a preview URL Google answers with HTTP 400
samples.evidence: font-family-picker.tsx:221 sets `data-font-weights={entry?.weights}` with `entry` from `CATALOG_BY_FAMILY` = curated `FONT_CATALOG` (line 46-48). Families picked through the "More fonts…" dialog come from the full library (font-catalog.full.ts) and become recents; e.g. `UnifrakturCook` (font-catalog.full.ts:1816, `weights: "700"`) is absent from font-catalog.data.ts, so the attribute is undefined, `previewWeight(undefined)` yields `400` (font-catalog.ts:184-187), and `css2?family=UnifrakturCook:wght@400&text=…` is exactly the HTTP-400 case the new helper's doc comment says it exists to avoid — stranding that recents row in a fallback face. The recents path needs the full-catalog entry (or to persist weights alongside the recent), not the curated lookup.

samples.summary: Design docs still document the in-view preview path as `ensureFontLink` and `data-wafflebase-font` as the single idempotency marker
samples.evidence: docs/design/slides/slides-fonts.md:202 ("an IntersectionObserver … that calls `ensureFontLink` only for on-screen rows"), :182 ("`data-wafflebase-font` attribute … is the idempotency" source of truth), :73 (cites `font-catalog.ts:142`, now shifted), and docs/design/docs/docs-font-controls.md:76/122/164 all describe the pre-change contract. After this diff previews go through `ensurePreviewFontLink` and there are two independent marker attributes; these out-of-diff docs are the specification other work reads and are now stale.

verdict.reason: The quoted short-circuit does exist (packages/docs/src/view/fonts.ts:302-305), but the consumer is unreachable, so the subset face cannot poison anything. The only claimed entry point, packages/frontend/src/app/docs/docs-formatting-toolbar.tsx:354, invokes it as `store.fonts?.ensureFont?.(family)` — double optional-chained — and no DocStore implementation defines a `fonts` member: the interface at packages/docs/src/store/store.ts:11 has none (grep for `fonts` in packages/docs/src/store returns no matches), MemDocStore (packages/docs/src/store/memory.ts:32) has none, and YorkieDocStore (packages/frontend/src/app/docs/yorkie-doc-store.ts:549) has none. The toolbar's own comment at :342-344 states DocStore "does not currently expose a `fonts` registry" and calls it a "yet-to-be-wired field". `new FontRegistry()` appears only in packages/docs/test/view/fonts.test.ts:63, never in any src file, and `onFontLoaded` (packages/docs/src/view/fonts.ts:285) has zero subscribers repo-wide — so the stated harm ("never fires its re-layout listeners, Canvas keeps measuring the subset") has no listener and no renderer behind it. `document.fonts.check` occurs exactly once repo-wide (fonts.ts:302); every live font path uses `fonts.load`/`loadingdone` instead (packages/frontend/src/app/slides/pdf-actions.ts:32-35, packages/docs/src/export/pdf-exporter.ts:251-256, packages/slides/src/view/editor/editor.ts:1061-1063). packages/docs is `"private": true` (package.json:4), so the public export at packages/docs/src/index.ts:188 has no external consumer either. There is no broken or bypassing call site; the concern is latent only if `store.fonts` is wired in future.
